Step 3 (In Water Over Your Head): A tuck surface dive is another option you can use to fulfillrequirement (p. 56).
Step 4 (In Water Over Your Head): Instead of lifting your legs as you would for apike surface dive, pull your knees toward your chest and pushthem upward as you point your head (p. 56).

Step 3 (Surface Dives): However, if your state, city, or local community requires a water depthgreater than 7 feet, it is important to abide by that mandate (p. 15).
